text:
toni_cs: Quick heads-up  ZenThera renewal is in flight but stalled on two novel blockers: (1) customer routed signing through their reseller (ResellCo) and procurement wants a reseller PO + reseller vendor code, (2) seat true-up adds 18 seats which impacts discount and proration. link to quote: https://docsend.com/s/zenthera-q2026.

liam_ae: reseller involvement complicates vendor flow. did ResellCo provide a PO or will they issue an invoice to the end-customer?

toni_cs: ResellCo sent a reseller PO (PO# RCL-55678) but our finance needs reseller vendor code and an agreement copy showing reseller authorization. Customer (zenthera@zenthera.ai) expects us to accept reseller PO on their behalf.

greg_fin: we need reseller legal docs + reseller agreement. Without reseller vendor code we cannot accept PO into AP. We can provision a temporary code but tax treatment differs.

ops_bot: vendor lookup for "ResellCo Ltd" -> no exact match. Suggest request: FIN-RES-TEMP-77 to allow PO attachment pending full vendor creation.

maya_legal: legal note: if ResellCo signs on behalf of the customer, we need a signed reseller authorization or deal registration proof. Alternatively, if end-customer signs SOW and ResellCo submits PO, accept with an explicit mention on SOW: "Purchase orders from ResellCo accepted on behalf of Buyer per reseller authorization dated <date>." I can draft a one-liner.

sophie_se: Sales confirmed reseller discount split: customer pays list, ResellCo reimburses net of 10% channel fee. Need pricing table updated and a line showing the reseller fee. Also, seat true-up: previous term had 52 seats, new total will be 70. Pricing tier jumps at 60 seats, which changes discount band.

liam_ae: can we show both scenarios in the SOW: (A) tier-applied as of signature if seats >=60, (B) if signed mid-term, proration applies for the 18 extra seats. customer asked for clarity and same-day signing.

maya_legal: paste for SOW: "Pricing: Seats 1-59 at standard rate; seats 60+ receive tier discount X. Additional seats added mid-term will be prorated from next billing cycle. Reseller purchase orders accepted provided reseller authorization is attached." use that exact text. I'll approve.

greg_fin: ok finance can accept a temporary vendor code FIN-RES-077 to attach PO and start invoice workflow. Permanent vendor requires reseller reg doc and VAT. I'll request tax paperwork from ResellCo.

toni_cs: i've asked ResellCo to attach registration and reseller authorization to the DocuSign envelope. creating DocuSign now with amended pricing table and the legal sentence.

sophie_se: DocuSign envelope created: https://docusign.com/envelope/zt-2026-resell routed to ResellCo signing authority then ZenThera contact (ops@zenthera.ai). Added note: include PO RCL-55678 and registrar doc in attachments.

ops_bot: Notice: DocuSign envelope expiration 10 days. Temporary vendor code FIN-RES-077 suggested in envelope comments.

liam_ae: ResellCo opened envelope at 1812349200 and left a comment: "Can you confirm if Tier discount applies retroactively to previous invoices?" they attached reseller authorization file.

maya_legal: response to reseller: "Tier discounts apply as of signature date and are not retroactive to prior invoices unless explicitly agreed in writing." use exact phrasing.

sophie_se: added that reply into the envelope comments. Also added pricing table showing effective date and prorated amounts for 18 seats. Included an example calculation snippet: `prorate = monthly_rate * (days_remaining / days_in_period) * additional_seats`.

greg_fin: ResellCo attached reg doc at 1812349800. Creating permanent vendor ENT-RES-902 pending quick tax check. I'll provision FIN-RES-077 so procurement can attach PO now.

toni_cs: customer replied they will sign today if PO + reseller auth accepted. I'm pushing for EOD.

liam_ae: update: ResellCo signed at 1812350400, ZenThera signed the SOW at 1812350600, PO attached by ResellCo and references FIN-RES-077. Great.

maya_legal: countersigned at 1812351000. I confirmed the SOW includes reseller clause and pricing tier language.

greg_fin: vendor created ENT-RES-902 at 1812351400. finance will reconcile channel fees and issue invoice to ResellCo per PO. Marking as closed from a procurement standpoint; CRM record updated: ARR adjusted to new seat count and revenue recognition notes added.

toni_cs: summary: Reseller PO accepted, SOW signed by both reseller and customer, permanent vendor created, pricing tier acknowledged, proration calculated. Closing thread. Thanks team! :tada:
